questions.question:
The given sentence is divided into four segments. Select the option that has the segment with a grammatical error.

She always / likes to / show on / her wealth.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is ‘3’ i.e. this part of the sentence has an error.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the third part of the given sentence, the phrase 'show on' is incorrect.
 
• In the given sentence, the correct phrase should be **'show off'.**
 
• The verb **'show off'** means to display something boastfully or ostentatiously.
 
 
• **Example:** ***She likes to show off her new car** to everyone she meets.*
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 3.

Correct sentence: *She always likes to show off her wealth.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Show off is a common phrasal verb meaning to exhibit one's talents or possessions in a noticeable or boastful manner.

 
 
• **Example:** *He loves to show off his talent on the guitar.*

questions.question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

Hard had she / thrown the basketball / when it fell / on the ground.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is ‘4’ i.e. this part of the sentence has an error.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the fourth part of the given sentence, the phrase 'Hard had she' is incorrect.
 
• In the given sentence, the correct phrase should be **'Hardly had she'.**
 
• This is a case of using an adverbial phrase in inversion to emphasize an action that just happened before something else.
 
 
• **Example:** ***Hardly had she** entered the room when the phone rang.*
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

Correct sentence: *Hardly had she thrown the basketball when it fell on the ground.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Hardly had is commonly used to describe an action that occurred just before another action. It often triggers an inversion in the sentence structure.

 
 
• **Example:** *Hardly had they finished their meal when the waiter brought the bill.*

questions.question:
Parts of the following sentence have been underlined and given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

__If it__ __will rain__ tomorrow, __I will__ stay __at home__.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is ‘3’ i.e. this part of the sentence has an error.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the third part of the given sentence, the phrase 'will rain' is incorrect.
 
• In conditional sentences, the word **'if'** is followed by the present tense to refer to the future.
 
 
• **Example:** ***If it rains** tomorrow, we will cancel the picnic.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct phrase should be **'rains'.**

Hence, the correct answer is option 3.

Correct sentence: *If it rains tomorrow, I will stay at home.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In conditional sentences, the present simple tense is used after **'if'** to talk about possible future events.

 
 
• **Example:** *If she goes to the party, she will see him there.*

questions.question:

questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. 'victory'.

__
 
• The word **"Defeat"** means the act of losing or being overcome in a battle, contest, or struggle. (पराजय)

 
 
• **Example: **The team faced a crushing defeat in the final match.
 
 
 
• **"Victory" **refers to the act of winning or triumphing over an opponent or challenge. (जीत)
 
 
• **Example: **Her victory in the competition was celebrated by everyone.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. 'victory'.

questions.question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Hospital for people with mental illnesses
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Asylum**.

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Asylum"** means an institution offering shelter and support to people who are mentally ill. (मानसिक रोगियों का अस्पताल)

 
 
• **Example: **The patient was admitted to an asylum for better care and treatment.
 
 
 
• **"Shelter" **refers to a place giving temporary protection from bad weather or danger. (आश्रय)
 
 
• **Example: **They found shelter under a large tree during the storm.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that a hospital for people with mental illnesses is called an **'Asylum'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Asylum**.

**Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Shelter **(आश्रय): A place giving temporary protection from bad weather or danger.

 
 
• **Example:** The refugees were provided shelter by the local community.
 
 
 
• **Druggist **(दवा विक्रेता): A person who is qualified to prepare and dispense medicinal drugs.
 
 
• **Example: **The druggist filled my prescription within minutes.
 
 
 
• **Hangar** (विमानशाला): A large building with an extensive floor area, typically for housing aircraft.
 
 
• **Example:** The airplane was moved into the hangar for maintenance.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

As I have no time to discuss the points, __so I wrote a email to her__.

options.text: so I wrote a e-mail to her
I wrote an email to her
so I wrote an e-mail for her
I write an email to her

questions.solution:
The correct answer is ‘2’ i.e. I wrote an email to her.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase 'I wrote an email to her' is correct because:
 
 
• The use of **'an'** before 'email' is grammatically correct as 'email' starts with a vowel sound.
 
• Using **'so'** is redundant because the conjunction **'As'** already conveys the cause-effect relationship.
 
 
 
• The other options are either grammatically incorrect or stylistically awkward.
 
 
• **Option 1** repeats 'so,' making it redundant.
 
• **Option 3** uses 'for' instead of 'to,' which changes the meaning slightly.
 
• **Option 4** uses the wrong verb tense 'write' instead of 'wrote.'
 
 

 

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

Correct sentence: *As I have no time to discuss the points, I wrote an email to her.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In English, using either 'a' or 'an' depends on the sound that follows the article, not necessarily the first letter of the word.
 
 
• **Example:** *He read an article about the subject.*

questions.question:
Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the given sentence.

A distinguished academecian, Amartya Sen has taught in India, Britain and the United States.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. 'Academecian'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Academecian"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is "Academician".
 
• **Academecian** does not have any meaning in English. It is a misspelling of the word "Academician".
 
• The correct word is **"Academician"** which means a member of an academy, especially one who is knowledgeable in a specific field. (अकादमीशियन)
 
 
• **Example: **Amartya Sen is a renowned academician known for his work in welfare economics.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. 'Academecian'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Britain** (ब्रिटेन): A country in Europe.

 
 
• **Example:** She traveled to Britain for her higher studies.
 
 
 
• **Taught** (सिखाया): Past tense of 'teach', meaning to impart knowledge or skill.
 
 
• **Example:** He taught mathematics at the university.
 
 
 
• **Distinguished** (प्रतिष्ठित): Recognized for excellence.
 
 
• **Example:** She is a distinguished scientist in the field of genetics.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Resistance
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Resistance"** means the refusal to accept or comply with something; the attempt to prevent something by action or argument. (प्रतिरोध)

 
 
• **Example: **The resistance of the local community to the new policy was evident in the protest march.
 
 
 
• **"Tolerance" **refers to the ability or willingness to tolerate the existence of opinions or behavior that one dislikes or disagrees with. (सहनशीलता)
 
 
• **Example: **The teacher's tolerance for different viewpoints made her classroom a welcoming place for all students.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Resistance'** is **'Tolerance'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Tenderness **(नम्रता): The quality of being gentle, kind, or affectionate.

 
 
• **Example:** The tenderness in her voice soothed the crying child.
 
 
 
• **Awareness **(जागरूकता): Knowledge or perception of a situation or fact.
 
 
• **Example: **Public awareness of environmental issues has increased significantly in recent years.
 
 
 
• **Reliance** (निर्भरता): Dependence on or trust in someone or something.
 
 
• **Example:** His reliance on his friends for support was evident during difficult times.
